تستهدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَهْدُوا (tastahdū) /tas.tah.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# تُسْتَهْدَوْا (tustahdaw) /tus.tah.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
